title: Park Guell visit
text: We had a wonderful time on the Park Güell tour with Sun2Spain! Our guide was friendly and super knowledgeable. We chose the 9:30 am slot, which turned out to be pretty busy since lots of groups arrive early, but it didn’t matter,everything ran smoothly and we got in right on time. Communicating with Sun2Spain was a breeze. our booking was confirmed with all the details and follow ups in under 5 minutes. We are so glad we went with them, especially since we had to change the date two days before due to some hiccups, and they handled it with no trouble at all. Highly recommended!
author: donam364

title: The Most Amazing Tour Guide!
text: Olga with Sun2Spain was the most amazing tour guide! Our visit to Park Guell would not have been the same without her expert knowledge of Gaudi and the construction of the park. She was great at being inquisitive about our thoughts as we toured, which would lead to extended talks about the different sections of the park, etc. She was a very bright person with an excellent demeanor and sense of humor. Thank you for providing a true highlight to our recent Viking Vesta cruise!
author: U8974SMnatalieh

title: Absolutely fantastic
text: We had an absolutely fantastic time! We booked this tour with From2Spain, and we had some elderly folks with us. The tour guide was incredibly helpful, and there were so many stops along the way that we felt so well taken care of. Thanks!!!
author: 507samya

title: Crash Course of Park Guell
text: I joined this tour because I found that all the tickets on the official website were sold out. The guide took me to main spots in the large parks in about an hour. Around 20 people participated in this tour. As the park is spacious, it was good for me to take a look at major architecture in the park. Please note that, the meeting point was Carmel entrance, not Carmel Park.
author: K_U

title: Great tour!
text: Booked this tour super last minute and it was the best decision! We arrived a few minutes late, but the group was there and waiting for us. We had the best tour guide Lena, her knowledge and excitement for the information she was sharing was unparalleled. She was great with making various stops and sharing plenty of information and also stopped at few areas for pictures, also offered up her photography skills to snap a quick pick of us. Overall a great tour and even better tour guide!
author: Fadile_K

title: Very good tour
text: I had a very good tour of the park and learned a lot about the architectural history of barcelona. The tour guide was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about the park and the history of the city
